title: Free electives pool of a department: courses its students may take as free electives (general/free_electives.json)

note.description: Optional rules or explanation shown above the list

courses.description: Each entry either points at a course (use course) or describes one itself (use code, name and ects). Never both.

course.description: Points at a course that is in a curriculum. Example: mathematics:1001. The name and ECTS then come from that course, so leave out code, name and ects.

code.description: For a course that is not in any curriculum on the site: its code, exactly as the university prints it, but without spaces and without the characters : and /. Example: 9001

offered_by.description: Name of the department that teaches it (only with code, name and ects)
